description: This file defines an immutable Java class ImmutableSource which implements the Source interface. It models a source configuration in a connectivity module, encapsulating fields like addresses, authorization context, header and payload mappings, reply target, acknowledgment labels, and enforcement policies. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization methods, migration logic for reply targets, and an internal builder class. The class is intended for use within a larger Java-based Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

classes.name: ImmutableSource
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Source interface encapsulating configuration details for a connectivity source, including addresses, authorization context, mappings, reply target, and acknowledgment labels. Supports JSON serialization, deserialization, migration, and building via its nested Builder class.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the set of addresses associated with this source.

methods.name: getConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for this source.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with this source.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of this source.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Quality of Service level if specified.

methods.name: getEnforcement
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the enforcement policy if specified.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing acknowledgement request details if specified.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing header mapping configuration if specified.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping configuration.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the reply target configuration if specified.

methods.name: isReplyTargetEnabled

methods.description: Overrides hashCode for source instances.

methods.name: toString

methods.name: migrateReplyTargetWithHeaders
